purpose: Give learners in New Zealand, the United Kingdom's four nations, and India a source-linked study pathway through the same MouldMaster Book and app topics.
claimBoundary: This editorial crosswalk supports study only. It does not establish formal equivalence, award qualifications or credits, satisfy required training hours, assess workplace competence, provide consent to assess, or grant authority to operate machinery.
localisation: MouldMaster's interface and Book remain in English. The cited CIPET qualification file records Hindi as an additional language for its qualification and model curriculum.

practiceActivities.title: Build a process-record worksheet
practiceActivities.description: Use a fictional case to separate target values from actual readings, note material and mould identity, describe a controlled change, and state who must approve it. Do not copy the example as a live recipe.

practiceActivities.title: Plan a quality check
practiceActivities.description: From a fictional drawing and specification, list the characteristic, measuring method, sample source, record, and escalation trigger. Use the supplied specification for limits and sampling.

practiceActivities.title: Complete a safety and 5S observation
practiceActivities.description: Review a photo or simulated work-area case, identify hazards and housekeeping issues, and write the safe stop-and-escalate action. This activity does not authorise machine operation or intervention.

practiceActivities.title: Write a defect hypothesis ledger
practiceActivities.description: List at least two plausible causes, the evidence that would distinguish them, the safe next check, and the condition that requires escalation.

practiceActivities.title: Prepare a shift handover
practiceActivities.description: Summarise fictional production status, material and tooling identity, quality checks, open issues, and next authorised actions without inventing process limits.

pathways.title: New Zealand Certificate in Plastics Processing (Level 3)
pathways.frameworkRef: NZQA qualification 4401 · optional Injection Moulding strand
pathways.scopeNote: The qualification includes an optional Injection Moulding strand. The MouldMaster mapping uses the existing NZQA readiness contract and Book chapter map as study context.
studyOutcomes: Explain safe injection moulding work, production instructions, and operating boundaries.
Relate polymer and mould conditions to process behaviour using the current grade, machine, and site evidence.
Interpret process monitoring, quality records, and defect evidence.
Recognise where tooling setup, routine service, assessment, and workplace competence require an authorised provider or employer.
formalRequirements: Provider-selected programme design, delivery, assessment, moderation, and workplace evidence.
Any standards assessment requires the provider's current NZQA consent and moderation arrangements.
MouldMaster completion does not award NZQA credits or show workplace competence.

pathways.title: Polymer processing technician
pathways.frameworkRef: Skills England apprenticeship standard ST1328, version 1.0
pathways.duration: Typically 36 months training, a 3-month assessment period, and 626 minimum hours for compliance
pathways.scopeNote: This occupational standard covers polymer processing technologies including injection moulding. It covers preparation, process monitoring, quality, records, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement; it is not an injection-moulding-only curriculum.
studyOutcomes: Prepare equipment and materials from a work instruction and identify safe limits.
Explain how to run and monitor a polymer process without substituting generic examples for controlled settings.
Plan quality checks, traceability records, housekeeping, and waste handling.
Use evidence to describe routine maintenance, process trials, troubleshooting, and escalation.
formalRequirements: An employer, training provider, and approved end-point assessment organisation control the apprenticeship and end-point assessment.
The standard's independent assessment includes workplace observation, an interview supported by a portfolio, and a test.
MouldMaster does not supply the apprenticeship hours, portfolio sign-off, or end-point assessment.

source.title: Skills England: ST1328 Polymer processing technician

pathways.title: SVQ in Scientific, Technical and Formulation Processing
pathways.frameworkRef: SCQF Level 5 code GP42 22 and Level 6 code GP43 23
pathways.status: Listed as accredited through 2028-11-30 in the Qualifications Scotland accreditation decision list dated 2026-10-27
pathways.duration: Workplace/provider arrangement; confirm the current award structure with the centre
pathways.scopeNote: This is a broad processing qualification, not an injection-moulding-specific award. MouldMaster's mapping is limited to transferable process knowledge and evidence practices.
studyOutcomes: Explain process steps, equipment, materials, monitoring, and safe work.
Record process observations and quality evidence clearly.
Use a structured troubleshooting approach and communicate workplace handovers.
Identify which learning requires the current SVQ units and workplace evidence.
formalRequirements: The awarding body's current SVQ units, an approved centre, and workplace competence evidence govern achievement.
The qualification is broader than injection moulding; providers must confirm how its current units relate to the learner's role.
MouldMaster does not confer SCQF credit or an SVQ.

pathways.title: Welsh Apprenticeship Framework pathway
pathways.status: Generic Welsh framework structure mapped; a plastics-specific framework crosswalk was not verified in this review
pathways.scopeNote: Welsh frameworks combine occupation-specific competence and technical knowledge qualifications, with Essential Skills Wales qualifications where applicable. This map supports general study themes only; the learner's provider must choose the applicable approved framework and pathway.
studyOutcomes: Use the Book to build polymer-processing background knowledge and safe evidence habits.
Connect Book topics to the occupational competence and technical knowledge qualifications selected by the provider.
Identify applicable communication, numeracy, and digital requirements from the chosen Welsh framework.
formalRequirements: The employer and provider must confirm the current Welsh framework, occupation-specific pathway, qualifications, and Essential Skills Wales requirements.
No plastics-specific Welsh apprenticeship equivalence is claimed by this MouldMaster mapping.
MouldMaster does not issue a Welsh apprenticeship completion certificate or regulated qualification.

pathways.title: Polymer processing operations apprenticeship framework
pathways.status: Framework No. 348 Issue 6 (08/25) shown on the current nidirect framework page
pathways.duration: Agreed by the apprentice, training contractor, and employer
pathways.scopeNote: This is a polymer-processing framework with competence and knowledge components. Its practical competence is workplace-based and commonly assessed by portfolio and observation.
studyOutcomes: Explain polymer-processing operations, safe work, and quality requirements.
Prepare evidence and questions for workplace competence development.
Use Book topics to support understanding of injection moulding within the wider polymer-processing role.
Identify required essential skills and employment-related responsibilities from the framework.
formalRequirements: Both the specified competence-based and knowledge-based qualifications are required.
Mandatory essential skills include application of number and communication at Level 2 and Digital ICT at Level 1, with the Level 2 option described by the framework.
The apprentice must be employed from day one; provider-controlled workplace assessment and certification remain external.

source.title: nidirect: Polymer processing operations Level 3 apprenticeship framework

pathways.title: Machine Operator – Injection Molding (MO-IM)
pathways.status: Approved 2025-05-26; next review date 2028-05-25 in the qualification file
pathways.duration: 600 hours: 210 theory, 360 practical, and 30 mandatory on-the-job training
pathways.scopeNote: This is the most injection-moulding-specific reference in the regional map. Its listed modules cover job/process basics, injection operations and troubleshooting, finished-product inspection, workplace health and safety/5S, office software, employability, entrepreneurship, and OJT.
studyOutcomes: Explain production instructions, material and mould readiness, and safe work.
Describe injection moulding operations, process monitoring, troubleshooting, and escalation.
Plan inspection of finished products against an approved reference.
Prepare for the practical training and OJT that the qualification requires.

modules.title: Basic concepts, job requirements, and process know-how
Injection moulding operations, process monitoring, and troubleshooting
MS Office / open-source office suite basics

formalRequirements: A training provider and awarding/assessment arrangements must deliver the official curriculum and assess its practical criteria.
The 360 practical hours and 30 mandatory OJT hours are external training requirements; Book reading or app activities do not count toward them.
The qualification file names Hindi as an additional language for its qualification/model curriculum; MouldMaster content is currently English.
